group: Procedures for Ball: Relief Areas, Dropping, Marking
title: Ball Dropped Correctly but Played from Outside Relief Area
question: After correctly dropping his ball from knee height, Michael's ball rolls outside the required relief area but he plays it from where it came to rest. What is the ruling?

choices.text: No penalty because the drop itself was correct.
General penalty for playing from a wrong place.
The ball must be re-dropped only, with no penalty.

explanation: There is no penalty for the drop itself if performed correctly, but if the ball comes to rest outside the required relief area and the player plays it from there, they have played from a wrong place and receive the general penalty (two strokes in stroke play or loss of hole in match play) under Rule 14.7a.
